title: A document with a hyperlink
concept: A Hyperlink ties a text source to a URL destination; the parser records all three, but link regions are not drawn.

annotations.note: HyperlinkURLDestination — the target. DestinationURL holds the web address; DestinationUniqueKey is the int key a Hyperlink points at.
HyperlinkTextSource — the document-level record of the in-story anchor. Its Self id is what the Hyperlink's Source names.
Hyperlink — ties Source (the text anchor) to Destination (the URL). The parser keeps Self, Name, Source, and Destination; the appearance attributes are read past.
